name: Brandfetch
summary: Brand data by domain, ticker, ISIN or crypto symbol: logos, colors, fonts, descriptions and company facts; plus brand-name search and brand context.

api_key.description: A Brandfetch API key (developers dashboard), sent as a Bearer token. Needed for every call except brand search.

client_id.description: A Brandfetch client id, needed only for the Brand Search API (passed as the c query parameter).

notes: Quota: one credit per Brand API, Brand Context API or Transaction API request; a 404 also uses a credit, 400 and 204 do not. Logo and image fetches from the returned CDN URLs are free. 429 quota_exceeded when the month's quota is used up.
Brand search authenticates with a client id (c query parameter) instead of the API key.
Pass cachedOnly=true to avoid a live index (and a charge) for brands Brandfetch has not seen.

endpoints.name: Get a brand
endpoints.summary: Name, description, logos, colors, fonts, images, links and company facts for a domain, URL, email, brand id, ticker, ISIN or crypto symbol.

identifier.description: Domain (nike.com), website URL, email address, brand id (id_...), ticker (NKE), ISIN or crypto symbol; resolved in that order.

allowNsfw.description: Unset: default handling; true: return regardless; false: filter NSFW brands out (404).

cachedOnly.description: true: answer only from the index; an unindexed brand returns 204 and costs nothing.

endpoints.name: Get a brand by domain
endpoints.summary: As brand.get, but the identifier is always read as a domain (no ticker collision).

allowNsfw.description: Unset: default handling; true: return regardless; false: filter NSFW brands out (404).

cachedOnly.description: true: answer only from the index; an unindexed brand returns 204 and costs nothing.

endpoints.name: Get a brand by ticker
endpoints.summary: Brand data for a stock or ETF ticker.

allowNsfw.description: Unset: default handling; true: return regardless; false: filter NSFW brands out (404).

cachedOnly.description: true: answer only from the index; an unindexed brand returns 204 and costs nothing.

endpoints.name: Get up to 100 brands
endpoints.summary: One result per identifier, in the order sent, each answered as brand.get would.

identifiers.description: Up to 100 identifiers (domains, URLs, emails, brand ids, tickers, ISINs).

cachedOnly.description: Answer from the index alone; unindexed brands come back 204.

endpoints.name: Search brands by name
endpoints.summary: Brands matching a name, each with its domain, icon and brand id: for autocomplete or resolving a name to a domain.
notes: Needs BRANDFETCH_CLIENT_ID (sent as c); the API key is not used.

endpoints.name: Get brand context
endpoints.summary: A structured brand narrative for a domain: identity, positioning, products and services, voice, visual style and competitors.

domain.description: Domain, a URL on it, or an email address on it.

cachedOnly.description: true: return only an already cached context, without crawling the domain.

endpoints.name: Identify a merchant from a transaction
endpoints.summary: The brand behind a raw card-transaction label.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the transaction took place.

notes: A read over POST; one credit.
